subject: Demo queue priority & on-stage camera blocking — Redwood activation
body:
From: Olivia Chen <olivia@techrise.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Demo queue priority & on-stage camera blocking for Redwood activation

Hi Soojin,

Great to be working with Redwood for TechRise Summit. Quick ask from our production team: your activation team requested priority spots in the demo queue and an on-stage camera operator to capture live product demos for the main stage segment on Day 2. We can usually grant demo priority to platinum sponsors, but camera blocking and a dedicated operator are add-ons.

Can you confirm:
- Number of 10–12 minute demos you expect per day (estimate)
- Whether you need the camera operator for the entire Day 2 main-stage window (09:00–13:00) or specific slots
- Any additional AV specs (camera feed, RTMP output, direct monitor for demos)

Attached a high-level stage block diagram and our standard AV spec. If you’re ok, I’ll draft a short addendum that lists demo priority (up to 6 demos per hour) and the camera operator fee.

Thanks,
Olivia Chen
Sponsorships Lead, TechRise Events
[attachment: stage_block_diagram.pdf (PDF, 480 KB)]
[attachment: av_specification.docx (DOCX, 230 KB)]

----
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia@techrise.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 09:10:23 -0800
Subject: Re: Demo queue priority & on-stage camera blocking for Redwood activation

Hi Olivia — thanks, this is timely. We definitely want the priority demos on Day 2 and would like a dedicated camera operator for the main-stage demo block, but want to confirm exact deliverables and costs before we sign anything. Quick answers below:

- Estimated demos: 10–14 total across the main-stage window (expecting more interest if we run live sign-ups and a raffle).
- Camera operator: prefer dedicated operator for 09:30–12:30 (three-hour block). We may want a short mic check and camera rehearsal at 09:00.
- AV needs: RTMP out to our stream, a clean HDMI feed for our laptop, and a stage monitor. Please confirm output resolution (we prefer 1080p30).

Internal: Kimberly / Logan, can you confirm operational feasibility and rough cost for the operator and RTMP feed? Also flag if we need additional crew for camera transitions and laptop handoff. Marissa, we’ll need a branded lower-third and a brief slide deck template for the operator to show during each demo.

If Olivia can send an addendum draft, we’ll route for approval.

Thanks —
Soojin Lee
Head of Field Marketing, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference

----
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 11:44:55 -0800
Subject: Re: Demo queue priority & on-stage camera blocking for Redwood activation

Soojin / team — copied ops details below after speaking with the AV vendor and on-site production lead. Summary:

- Camera operator cost (3 hours + setup/rehearsal): $1,200 flat (includes 1 operator + B-cam kit).
- RTMP feed: $400 one-time (encoder + stream engineer).
- Additional stage tech for laptop transitions: $300 per tech (we recommend 1 floater for the 3-hour block).
- Priority demo queue: production can reserve up to 6 demo slots/hour but requires a 10-minute buffer between demos for screen swap and mic handoff; will require an on-site queue manager (we can provide or you can staff).

Operational notes / constraints:
- Load-in for demo kit (4 flight cases) must be scheduled during exhibitor load-in windows — we should request Monday morning early access if possible.
- Power and patching: we need an on-side rack spot; attaching proposed rack list and load-in schedule.
- Camera blocking: they will mark the stage with tape; no signage or additional props allowed within the blocking area for safety.

Attachments: load-in_schedule.xlsx, rack_list.xlsx

If we proceed, recommend Soho (our field tech) on-site as queue manager to ensure demos run to time.

-Kimberly
Director, Events Operations
Redwood Inference
[attachment: load-in_schedule.xlsx (XLSX, 45 KB)]
[attachment: rack_list.xlsx (XLSX, 14 KB)]

----
From: Olivia Chen <olivia@techrise.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 16:22:10 -0800
Subject: Re: Demo queue priority & on-stage camera blocking for Redwood activation

Soojin / team — thanks for the quick responses, and great to see operations lined up. I’ve attached a short addendum draft and the final stage block with camera sightlines. Highlights:

- Priority demo queue: up to 6 demos per hour during requested window, addendum includes cancellation/late policy.
- Camera operator fee noted ($1,200) and RTMP fee ($400) — addendum total add-on fee: $1,600.
- On-site queue manager: TechRise can provide one at no extra charge for the rehearsal on Day 2; production prefers Redwood provide one for the live demo window (we’ll list this as an option).

Please review the addendum and, if ok, sign via DocuSign (link below). We’ll finalize the load-in window once signed and share a single-point-of-contact for production day.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.net/REDWOOD-TRS-addendum
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-demo-ops

Attachments: TRS_addendum_camera_demo.pdf, stage_block_diagram_final.pdf

Best,
Olivia Chen
Sponsorships Lead, TechRise Events
